scope.input_authority: explicit ledger-derived retrieval, analytic, temporal, and belief/constraint views only
scope.future_learned_policy_gate: only after every E0.17 invariant and manipulation passes

action_semantics.ignore: discard only unverified noise for the current policy call; never delete ledger evidence
action_semantics.stage: emit a candidate-only repeated-procedure or future-skill proposal with ledger-only support
action_semantics.link: emit an advisory cross-view relation over two or more supported explicit items
action_semantics.retrieve: select supported explicit items for the current query without creating persistent state
action_semantics.summarize: emit a rebuildable advisory compression artifact preserving every protected field and support
action_semantics.structure: emit an advisory typed constraint/graph projection while keeping unresolved items explicit
action_semantics.request_evidence: return a witnessed evidence-gap request; never manufacture support

compression.summary_rule: canonical item-kind and content digest plus explicit protected manifests; summary text is advisory and never an evidence root
compression.deletion_rule: any invalidated source support disables the artifact before reuse; rebuild only from the surviving explicit frontier

skill_candidate.required_support: every staged repetition names a verified observed ledger event

accounting.storage: exact canonical bytes for decisions, compression artifacts, and skill candidates

future_comparison.success: learned policy improves registered long-horizon quality or reduces retrieval/storage cost by at least 10 percent without ID, OOD, protected-region, grounding, contradiction, temporal, unresolved, rebuild, or deletion regression

failure_branches.tail_loss: reject compression and retain higher-resolution explicit views
failure_branches.unsupported_summary: keep summaries advisory only and exclude them from answer evidence
failure_branches.no_value: retain deterministic admission and retrieval rules
failure_branches.environment_overfit: restrict the policy to that environment
failure_branches.explicit_memory_selected: train only over explicit ledger-derived views; native memory remains retired

kill_criteria.K1: the E0.16 selection or split registry hash drifts
kill_criteria.K2: a policy decision appends or mutates authoritative ledger state
kill_criteria.K3: a decision or artifact cites memory, slot, summary, or policy identifiers as evidence
kill_criteria.K4: compression loses any registered region, contradiction, refutation, temporal qualifier, support event, or unresolved item
kill_criteria.K5: a compression artifact differs after clean rebuild from the same explicit frontier
kill_criteria.K6: a tombstoned or otherwise invalidated support leaves an artifact reusable
kill_criteria.K7: a skill candidate lacks three verified repetitions or promotes itself
kill_criteria.K8: ignore discards verified evidence or request_evidence invents support
kill_criteria.K9: source-item or byte capacity can be exceeded
kill_criteria.K10: policy, compression, retrieval, or storage accounting is incomplete
kill_criteria.K11: any frozen split hash changes or an OOD axis overlaps training
kill_criteria.K12: E0.17 reads accuracy metrics, trains a policy, or authorizes E0.18, MoE, continual updates, or promotion

manipulations: M2 dropped protected-region coverage is rejected
M3 dropped contradiction or refutation is rejected
M4 dropped temporal qualifier is rejected
M5 hidden unresolved item is rejected
M6 omitted source support is rejected
M7 tombstoned support disables the artifact
M8 changed rebuild source hash is rejected
M9 memory or summary IDs cannot become evidence
M10 policy has no direct ledger-write path
M11 unsupported or under-repeated skill candidate is rejected
M12 stale ontology or ledger frontier is rejected
M13 source-item and serialized-byte caps fail closed
